monitoring.title: Real-Time Monitoring
monitoring.description: IoT sensors installed in the field that continuously measure humidity, temperature, and nutrients.

predictive.description: Algorithms that predict irrigation and fertilization needs.

alerts.title: Smart Alerts
alerts.description: Automatic notifications when humidity or nutrient levels are outside the optimal range.
